metadata.description: Standalone PRP engineering toolkit: a self-contained prp-plan / prp-implement / prp-loop workflow with Serena LSP codebase search, cross-session memory keyed by Jira ticket + branch, Jira context injection, and a personal knowledge base.

plugins.name: codebase-intelligence
plugins.description: Standalone PRP workflow — prp-plan / prp-implement / prp-loop — with Serena LSP structural codebase search, cross-session memory, Jira context injection, a personal KB (local FTS5 vault index), a bounded closed-loop runner with contract-mandated stop rules and an independent verifier, and prp-orchestrate: spec-driven agent teams that groom a Definition-of-Ready spec, audit the whole artifact chain before any code exists, freeze cross-lane contracts, ship one demoable checkpoint per user story, and gate the integrated branch (CI-parity + Copilot/bugbot parity + constitution) before any PR opens. Run state lives in the Obsidian vault rather than the repo, and every PR gets its title and body from pr-description automatically — `[TICKET] task description`, written to the vault before the PR is opened. No prp-core required.
